sources.stated_purpose: Indigent criminal defense inquiries within the contract and applicable eligibility.
sources.limitations: The county superior court identifies the contracted law office and the law office website publishes the professional address. Public defenders serve eligible clients in matters within their statutory or contracted remit; the address is not an independent medical-abuse investigation or general civil legal advice channel. Reconfirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction, eligibility and channel purpose before use. Do not send confidential information by ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
